title: Viewports other than root default to "linear" texture filtering, even with project settings being set to "nearest"
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.6.2.stable.arch_linux [001aa128b], v4.7.beta.custom_build [9a33066a2]


### System information

Godot v4.6.2.stable (001aa128b) - Arch Linux #⁠1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 08 May 2026 09:29:23 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Laptop GPU - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11800H @ 2.30GHz (16 threads) - 15.35 GiB memory

### Issue description

Any window that's not root doesn't use the project setting `rendering/textures/canvas_textures/default_texture_filter` applied, this includes but probably isn't limited to `Window`s, `Popup`s, `OptionButton`'s & `MenuButton`'s `PopupMenu`s, `SubViewport`s ... any node that inherit from `Viewport`.

When `rendering/textures/canvas_textures/default_texture_filter` is set to anything else than `Linear`, any `Viewport` or extension of it stay on `Linear` if not explicitly edited manually.

### Steps to reproduce

#### Steps

1. Change <kbd>rendering/textures/canvas_textures/default_texture_filter</kbd> in Project Settings to <kbd>Nearest</kbd>
2. Create a scene with a <kbd>Node</kbd> as root
3. Add a <kbd>TextureRect</kbd> node to the scene
    1. Create a sufficiently large <kbd>PlaceholderTexture</kbd> in the <kbd>Texture</kbd> field (MRP has it on 64x64px)
    2. Use an anchor preset to make it visible
3. Add a <kbd>Window</kbd> node to the scene
    1. Add a copy of the aforementioned <kbd>TextureRect</kbd> node as a child to this node
4. Observe in editor how the texture is rendered linearly in the `Window` node opposed to by nearest on the other `TextureRect` node
    1. Same happens in at runtime

#### MRP Usage

1. Open the project in the latest release (4.6.2.stable)
2. Run it
3. Left is the texture as part of the main viewport
4. Use the buttons on the right to open the different windows, popups, and popup menus
5. The bottom right texture is from a `SubViewport`
